content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the NDUAT Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: NDUAT Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Young Professional-I (Post 1): M.Sc.(Ag)/ M.Sc. (Horticulture)/ M.Sc. (Hort) Fruit Science/M.Sc. Life Science. Experience of working in the areas of Fruit Breeding, Plant Breeding, Plant Biotechnology (Desirable). Young Professional-I (Post 2): M.Sc. Ag./ G.P.B. (YP-I). Junior Research Fellow (JRF): M.Sc. (Horticulture) Vegetable Science/ M.Sc. (Ag) Genetics and Plant Breeding. High academic attainment with 1st class in graduate and post graduate examination. Junior Research Assistant (JRA): Master of Fisheries Science (M.F.Sc.) degree with 1st class in both Graduate and Post-graduate examinations. Two-Three years field/lab experiences preferably in eastern Uttar Pradesh (Desirable), Expertise in Fish identification and water quality analyzing techniques (Desirable), At least one research paper in Science Citation Indexed(SCI) Journal (Desirable), Having experience in advanced statistical techniques using statistical software (Desirable), Demonstrated ability to collect, analyze, interpreter data and prepare manuscripts (Desirable), Ability to conduct activities independently with minimal support from PI and Co-PIS (Desirable). Young Professional-I (Post 5): M.Sc. Ag.

content_sections.heading: NDUAT Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow (JRF): Maximum age 28 years as on 01.04.2026. Junior Research Assistant (JRA): Maximum age 28 years as on 01.04.2026. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC/Women/Differently abled candidates as per government rules.

content_sections.heading: NDUAT Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Young Professional-I: Rs. 30,000/- per month. Junior Research Fellow (JRF): Rs. 37,000/- p.m. for the first two years and Rs. 42,000/- after redesignation by the committee. Junior Research Assistant (JRA): Rs. 25,000/- per month for the first two years and Rs. 28,000/- for the third year.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NDUAT Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NDUAT recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is through a walk-in interview, and interested candidates should appear for the interview on 03 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced by NDUAT?
faq.answer: Acharya Narendra Deva University of Agriculture & Technology has announced a total of 5 vacancies for the posts of Young Professional-I, Junior Research Fellow, and Junior Research Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in relevant fields such as Horticulture, Agriculture, Life Science, Fisheries Science, or Genetics and Plant Breeding.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the NDUAT recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 28 years as on 01.04.2026. Age relaxation is provided for SC/ST/OBC/Women/Differently abled candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional-I post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Young Professional-I post is Rs. 30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post?
faq.answer: The JRF will receive Rs. 37,000/- per month for the first two years, with a potential increase to Rs. 42,000/- after redesignation.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for NDUAT recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the NDUAT jobs?
faq.answer: The application process is through a walk-in interview. Interested candidates need to appear at the interview venue with all required documents on the specified date.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Acharya Narendra Deva University of Agriculture & Technology, Ayodhya, Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original certificates, self-attested photocopies, and two passport-size photographs.
